name: Uncivil Discourse

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly reduces damage in exchange for improved cooling.

perks.name: Overclocked Heatsink
perks.desc: Slightly increases damage in exchange for reduced cooling.

perks.name: Enhanced Heatsink
perks.desc: Strong battery life. Reduces heat generation.

perks.name: Ionized Heatsink
perks.desc: A large, heavy battery. Increases the time it takes to vent, in exchange for greatly reduced heat generation.

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Heatsink
perks.desc: Lightweight, agile battery. Increases handling and vent speed.

perks.name: Tactical Heatsink
perks.desc: This weapon has multiple small improvements. Slightly improves stability, vent speed, and range.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.desc: While at low heat, this weapon has improved range, handling, and accuracy.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.desc: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.

notes: Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@cammycakesgaming (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for 6s. Uncivil Discourse is, right now, an S/A-Tier special ammo 180RPM hand cannon that's borderline oppressive in PvP - probably twice as good as Forerunner. It's a Heat weapon - which means you get an ersatz Reconstruction for free from the passive cooling, so you just have to run over ammo blocks to auto-reload. The Dynamic Heat frame means that when you cancel a manual vent at <12.5%, you get ×0.5 heat generation for 6s or until stowed. The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows the TTK, at base, is 0.667s (2c1b). There's nothing to compare against, but the stats are high across the board, especially with enhanced perks. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/3146657389 for yourself, once the formulas have been worked out. For the barrel perk, with all the stats being so high, there's no wrong choice - if you're using Shrewd Survivor armour the two-piece Reflex Action perk boosts Handling so Range or Stability work. For the Battery Perk, the only real choice is Overclocked Heatsink - with this perk alone providing a ×1.02 damage boost. For a duelling roll, in the first trait perk column Lone Wolf is the top choice to improve Aim Assist, Airborne Effectiveness and ADS speed. Alternatively Delicate Tuning works like a Heat weapon's mirror to Closing Time, boosting Range, Handling and Accuracy when a weapon's cold with the benefits reducing to half strength at 50% heat, or Keep Away boosts Reload, Range and Accuracy when there's no enemies within 15m. In the second column, Precision Instrument means you can 1c2b with a 160 weapons stat, or Opening Shot makes hitting your first crit easier. The Air-Cooled Core origin trait is only really relevant with manual vents (reloads) - you'll have boosted Reload Speed after sprinting which procs the better Handling and ADS movement speed after reloading, but unfortunately to proc Accelerated Assault you need to hit 3 times with 1.2-4s between each hit for the cooling and extra damage which isn't ideal if you're trying to hit an optimal TTK. Recommended MW: Cooling Efficiency, with a Heat Generated mod/enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for burst damage against Banes, Majors, Champions and Minibosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Uncivil Discourse is the first of a new subfamily of special ammo Dynamic Heat hand cannons which are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, providing an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against red-bar enemies and ×1.325 against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×0.5 heat generation if you manually cancel a vent animation at <12.5% of maximum heat, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The there's nothing to really compare this against, but you can see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3146657389 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. You might find you need a little help with the recoil control from the barrel perk, although extra Handling is also nice. For the battery perk, Overclocked Heatsink provides free ×1.02 damage for a slightly slower vent speed - not a problem if you manually reload anyway - Particle Repeater helps Stability or Light Heatsink or Tactical Heatsink improve gunfeel. There plenty of good rolls available for burst damage, or backup boss damage - Air Trigger, mostly for the +20 Ammo Generation making double special weapon loadouts easier to maintain, but also for the ability to jump reload is probably the top first trait perk column park, but anything that improves manual vent speed is worth considering. In the second column, Jolting Feedback applies Jolt after 7 hits (6 when enhanced and 4 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage, but Frenzy's here, as is Precision Instrument and Desperate Measures for builds that spam melee or grenade abilities. Thermal Atomization is more of a "one for the Vault just in case they fix the explosion damage" choice. For the Origin Trait Air-Cooled Core improves handling and ADS speed when heat is <10%, and boosts Vent Speed for 6s after sprinting. If you're very lucky you'll drop a weapon with the much better option of Accelerated Assault which passively reduces heat by 10% and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within 1.6s. If you're interested, it's modelled on the DL-44 blaster pistol used by Han Solo. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost heat generation, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

SpaceMonkey (PvE / God-PvE): "A cool new weapon type but sadly pretty pigeonholed in usage. It is the best Lucky Pants hand cannon by a wiiiiide margin now, especially if you can pick up an Accelerated Assault roll. Outside of that in PvE it's basically just a worse sniper rifle, and special snipers have had a rough time in PvE for a while now. In PvP this thing melts - it's basically a better Forerunner." Recommended MW: Handling.
